Revenue.Reason: Revenue is a numerical business metric. Median is used because it is not affected by unusually high or low campaign revenue values.

Platform.Reason: Platform is categorical. Missing values are replaced with the most frequently used platform.

Campaign_Type.Reason: Campaign type is categorical, so the most common campaign type preserves the existing distribution.

Language.Reason: Language is categorical. Filling with the most common language keeps the dataset consistent.

Engagement_Score.Reason: Engagement Score is numerical. Median prevents extreme values from affecting the imputed result.

Campaign_ID.Reason: Campaign_ID is a unique identifier and should never be guessed or imputed. Records with missing Campaign_ID are removed.
